cards.note: Self-contained npm bundle: dsh.bundle.patch inserts the row, installed via `dsh plugin --profile web add`; no repository-plugins row and no dsh.plugin.json (README now documents the path).
The manifest already declares dsh.client (platform web + ./client); there is no legacy dshClient field or dsh.plugin.json to merge, and no prepare step rewrites the packed manifest.
The client half declares dsh.client and exports the built ./client bundle, so the alpha.2 scan admits it; the row was verified in the real __DSH_BOOT__ manifest.
No ctx.get(...) or undeclared property access: the client half injects exactly the two services it uses (slots, locale) via export const inject.
No optional host service is probed; slots and locale are guaranteed by the web profile scope, so hard inject entries are correct.
The plugin never subscribes to session/event and derives no session state from event fields.
No ctx.sessions or client-side session aggregation; the widget is purely decorative and session scoping comes from the dock slot.
No tasks.peek / job-output tailing anywhere in the plugin.
The host half is a documented no-op; it injects/calls none of httpServer, tasks or onTaskDone.
No ImageAttachmentRef, read_image or persisted image metadata in the plugin.
The plugin neither registers nor parses read_image output.
No DeepSeek adapter, image request interceptor or attachment cache.
No APIProxy or ctx.remote usage; the client half only talks to ctx.slots and ctx.locale.
Target is alpha.2, not alpha.1; the plugin persists no third-party SessionEvents (net state per A2-01).
No host source patches and no internal session-view imports; the plugin is not in any patches/ directory.
No launcher wrapper, SDK/ACP integration or hardcoded profile path.
No headless wrapper or stdout/stderr parsing.
No tool presentation mode, PTC preset or dispatch waterfall usage.
The plugin ships no permission/approval/WebFetch policy and no tools.
No custom loopback HTTP/WS/RPC routes, browser pages or /api handlers.
The plugin is not a model provider and registers no settings page.

Ships zh/en copy through the official ctx.locale.register dictionary RPC, not a third-party language pack; no custom i18n patch to retire (the typed LocaleNamespaceMap augmentation stays documented as elided).
No subagent orchestration or model selector.
Informational: no plugin code change; the official DeepSeek adapter attaching the package name/version is a deployment privacy decision, recorded in the report.
No platform shell or directory-picker workarounds.
No session-log-deepseek usage or LLM request path.

No browser acceptance script or wrapper in the tree; the migration still ran the boot-manifest acceptance on alpha.2 (row id == package name, advertised combo URL 200 and the bundle registers under the package name).
No userQuestions.registerProvider or structured-question answerer.
No agent-preset inference or agent-presets roots.
No isTokenDelta / token-stream handling.
The bundle layer inserts one row and reuses no dsh-base composition of its own; telemetry defaults stay the deployment profile's concern.
No direct @earendil-works/pi-ai dependency or provider/auth plugin surface.

dsh-client-runtime dropped from dsh.client.inject, peers and meta; ctx.slots re-homed to dsh-client-ui-renderer, ctx.locale to dsh-client-locale, ClientContext to @deepseek-ai/cordis; ui-slots/ui-primitives no longer listed as inject rows (platform seed words).
All three ids agree with the package name: the row name and the generated __ModuleLoader__.load id are @bench/dsh-bench-sidebar-spur and package.json#name is the baseline.
The plugin reads no session timeline or user-message content.
The plugin does not touch the composer DOM; it only registers a dock entry.
No MarkdownText or fenced CodeBlock rendering (the braid is an elided SVG component).
No ctx.connection.api usage; no history/transcript reads.
No subagent descriptor construction or assertion.
No ctx.workspaces or ctx.uiWorkspace navigation calls.
The plugin produces no third-party persisted SessionEvents; the restored ignorable semantics have no producer here.
No ctx.remote calls or Remote failure handling.
Peer graph rebuilt for the cohort: dsh-client-runtime removed, every DSH peer on ^0.1.2-alpha.2, dsh-client-ui-renderer added, and @deepseek-ai/cordis corrected to ^4.0.1.
No Node-version workarounds or CI matrix in the plugin; the verification boot ran on Node 24.21 (outside the 24.0-24.11.1 failure window).
The plugin does not consume pluginInventory/list or validate PluginInventorySnapshot.
No ctx.remote.$host or host.describe usage.
The plugin neither composes profiles nor peers dsh-tool-todo/subagent/agent/terminal-bash, so sessionProjections does not enter its graph.
No ctx.settings.register/update/get; the plugin registers no settings namespace.
